scope: Development-only plan; no inference requested or performed. Baseline midterm_20261012_full_v1 and fingerprinted source remain unchanged.
interpretation_limits: Typed-correct is an answer-scoring property, not proof of complete clinical support. Flagged correct drafts must not be called false verifier verdicts without scope/citation/computation review.

Among 57 flagged typed-correct drafts, logged initial checks show 29 valid citations without scope warnings, 19 no citations, 7 field/scope warnings, and 2 unavailable field checks; completeness remains unestablished.
Among 31 withheld losses, 26 initial citation checks were clean, 2 warned, 2 were unavailable, and 1 had no citations. Independent calculation gates still matter.
Error-excluded and paired non-error accuracy are descriptive conditional outcomes, not causal estimates of removing errors or verification.

Null, zero and empty-list outcomes can be scored equivalently for empty numeric references while differing in verifier provenance requirements; distinguish supported empty results from policy abstentions.

A Python row containing a timestamp, resource identifier and another scalar can be accepted as a generic scalar list, while the verdict emits only the timestamp. A typed scorer may accept both, but the independent-tool agreement check properly rejects the unequal computation contract. Example: 58dca5f1f34e6a0994b147eb.
The first verifier cleared 25 typed-wrong drafts: agreement with an independent recomputation establishes execution agreement, not correct question interpretation or complete evidence support.

proposed_development_ablations.name: Explicit inspection versus final computation contract
proposed_development_ablations.change_to_test: Separate diagnostic inspection data from the final typed calculation result, or add explicit inspection/compute modes. Only a successful finite scalar/list-of-answer-values computation becomes independent verification evidence; diagnostic dictionaries, object lists and mixed result-row metadata never do.
required_regressions: Dictionary diagnostics followed by a valid scalar calculation
Object-list diagnostics followed by a valid calculation
Earlier valid scalar followed by diagnostics cannot silently become stale final evidence
Returned calculation payload and reported verdict must agree
No extra tool or token ceiling allowance

proposed_development_ablations.name: Bounded verifier contract recovery
proposed_development_ablations.change_to_test: Before emitting an unrepairable independent_check, provide structured local feedback that inspection output cannot establish a final answer, and allow correction only within the existing shared token/tool budget. Keep failed source checks, incomplete scope, stale computation and tool/verdict disagreement blocking release.
required_regressions: Failed later fetch invalidates prior computation
Correction never releases based on reference-answer equality

proposed_development_ablations.name: Budget and preview discipline with strict source checks
proposed_development_ablations.change_to_test: Use compact diagnostic summaries and declared final-result schemas so inspection does not consume verification capacity. Compare an explicit verifier work reserve under the same aggregate 200000-token/30-tool ceilings against current scheduling; do not raise ceilings or skip independent source checks.
measurements: Typed paired accuracy with all first-attempt failures retained

proposed_development_ablations.name: Repair transition diagnostics
proposed_development_ablations.change_to_test: On fixed development/pilot questions, log candidate correctness, issue provenance, computation coverage and released correctness separately. Retain the one-repair protocol and strict release gate; compare operational completion and semantic mistakes without replacing primary first-attempt outcomes.
measurements: Wrong drafts accepted by clear independent verdict
Repair role and shared budget usage

proposed_development_ablations.name: Shared question semantics across roles
proposed_development_ablations.status: Source-based hypothesis; not a measured causal explanation of this benchmark gap.
proposed_development_ablations.change_to_test: Give verification the same explicit wall-clock comparison, Observation effectiveDateTime, prescription validityPeriod.start, and hospital/ICU encounter rules supplied to analysis, preferably through a shared tested scope/time helper. Retain independent retrieval and calculation; matching computations cannot substitute for correct filters and fields.
required_regressions: Wall-clock timestamp comparison without invented timezone conversion
Observation event time versus issued time
Hospital versus ICU encounter and partOf scope
Wrong filter reproduced by both roles must remain a semantic error
measurements: Typed-wrong drafts receiving a clear verdict
Paired typed accuracy with all first-attempt errors retained

retained_gates: Actual Python result equals reported recomputation
